Fixtures for macOS Intel host health. The pmset, sysctl, top, memory_pressure and normalized scalar battery samples come from sanitized macOS 26.5.2 discovery. Battery IDs are synthetic. The native-architecture scalar is the verified Intel hw.cputype value (7); Apple Silicon reports 16777228, including when uname reports x86_64 under translation. Platform and formatted Docker JSON fixtures match the measured platform and engine budget; the Docker byte value is synthetic because discovery recorded rounded memory. The powermetrics fixture contains real allowlisted CPU/GPU die temperature and fan scalars captured on macOS 26.5.2 after the owner installed the fixed-argument grant. Recorded text fixtures normalize trailing whitespace; numeric values are unchanged. Only scalar allowlisted values enter snapshots.

The top-unpadded fixture contains allowlisted CPU lines from idle qualification on the same host. Apple top globalstats.c computes and prints integer hundredths without padding: https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/top/blob/main/globalstats.c .
